lines.8: She does this stuff without even realizing it. What a terrifying girl.
lines.10: 「Hey, don't put your arm around the back of my neck!」
lines.12: Could she be doing this unconsciously so she can legally kill me when she wakes up!?
lines.13: I don't even understand my own theory, but it still scares me.
lines.15: I peeled Konoe off me, then grabbed her by the ankle.
lines.16: 「Get all the way to the far end!」
lines.17: I sent Konoe sliding like a bowling ball.
lines.18: SKRRRSH! She skidded across the floor and slammed into the stack of futons.
lines.19: The impact sent the futon stack toppling down onto Konoe.
lines.22: 「She's still asleep after all that... She must be exhausted.」
lines.23: I moved even farther away before crawling back into my futon.
